objects.contents:
Class $\mathcal{C}$가 다음의 data

•

$\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C})$ : class of objects

•

$\mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{C})$ : class of morphisms

으로 이루어져 있고, 다음 조건

•

$\exists\;\! \mathrm{dom}, \mathrm{cod} \colon \mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{C}) \to \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C})\qquad$(domain, codomain)

이 때 $\mathrm{Hom}(A,B) = \{f \in \mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{C}) \,|\, \mathrm{dom}f = A,\; \mathrm{cod}f = B\}$으로 정의한다.

•

$\forall f \in \mathrm{Hom}(A,B) \;\text{ and }\; \forall g \in \mathrm{Hom}(B,C),\; \exists g \circ f \in \mathrm{Hom}(A,C)$

•

$\exists \mathrm{id}_{A} \in \mathrm{Hom}(A,A),\;\bigg\{\begin{aligned}& \forall f \in \mathrm{Hom}(A,B),\; f \circ \mathrm{id}_{A} = f \\ & \forall g \in \mathrm{Hom}(B,A),\; \mathrm{id}_{A} \circ g = g \end{aligned}$

•

$\forall f,g,h \in \mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{C}),\;(h \circ g) \circ f = h \circ (g \circ f)\qquad$[associativity]

를 만족시키면, $\mathcal{C}$를 category라 한다. $\mathrm{Hom}(A,B)$의 element $f$를 $f \colon A \to B$로 표시한다.

1.

$\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\,\mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{C})$가 set이면 small category라 한다.

2.

각 $\mathrm{Hom}(A,B)$가 모두 set이면 locally small category라 한다.

Category $\mathcal{C}$에 대하여

$\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}}) = \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\qquad \mathrm{Mor}_{\mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}}}(A,B) = \mathrm{Mor}_{\mathcal{C}}(B,A)$

으로 정의된 $\mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}}$를 opposite category of $\mathcal{C}$라 한다.

1.

$f \colon A \to B$에 대하여

$\exists f^{-1} \colon B \to A,\;\bigg\{\begin{aligned}& f^{-1 } \circ f = \mathrm{id}_{A} \\&f \circ f^{-1} = \mathrm{id}_{B}\end{aligned}$

를 만족하면 $f$를 isomorphism이라 한다. 또한 두 object $A,B$ 사이에 isomorphism이 존재하면, $A,B$는 isomorphic하다고 하며 $A \cong B$로 표시한다.

2.

$f \colon A \to B$가

1)

$\forall g_1,g_2 \colon A' \to A,\; (f \circ g_1 = f \circ g_2 \implies g_1 = g_2)\qquad$[left cancellative]

를 만족하면 $f$를 monic(monomorphism)이라 한다.

2)

$\forall g_1,g_2 \colon B \to B',\; (g_1 \circ f = g_2 \circ f \implies g_1 = g_2)\mkern22mu$[right cancellative]

를 만족하면 $f$를 epic(epimorphism)이라 한다.

3.

$r \circ s = \mathrm{id}_{A}$이면 $s$를 section(right inverse), $r$을 retraction(left inverse)이라 한다. 이 때, section은 monic, retraction은 epic이다.

4.

$f \colon A \to B$와 object $C$에 대하여

•

$f_{\ast} \colon \mathrm{Hom}(C,A) \to \mathrm{Hom}(C,B),\quad g \mapsto f \circ g \qquad$(post-composition)

•

$f^{\ast} \colon \mathrm{Hom}(B,C) \to \mathrm{Hom}(A,C),\quad g \mapsto g \circ f \qquad$(pre-composition)

으로 정의한다. 이 때,

1)

$f \text{ is monic}\iff \forall C \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\;f_\ast \text{ is injective}$

2)

$f \text{ is epic} \iff \forall C \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\;f^\ast \text{ is surjective}$

3)

$f \text{ is section} \iff \forall C \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\;f_\ast \text{ is surjective}$

4)

$f \text{ is retraction} \iff \forall C \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\;f^\ast \text{ is injective}$

5)

$\begin{aligned}[t] f \text{ is isomorphism} &\iff \forall C \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; f_{\ast} \text{ is bijective}\\[-0.25em] &\iff \forall C \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; f^{\ast}\text{ is bijective}\end{aligned}$

Category $\mathcal{C},\mathcal{D}$에 대하여 class function $F \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{D}$가

•

$\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}) \to \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{D}),\quad \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(A,B) \to \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{D}}(F(A),F(B))$

•

$F(\mathrm{id}_{A})= \mathrm{id}_{F(A)}\mkern96mu \forall A \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C})$

•

$F(g \circ f) = F(g) \circ F(f)\qquad \forall f,g \in \mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{C})$

를 만족하면 $F$를 (covariant) functor라 한다.

1.

Functor $F \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{D}$가

1)

$\forall A, B \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(A,B)\to \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{D}}(F(A),F(B))$ is injective

를 만족하면 $F$를 faithful functor라 한다.

2)

$\forall A, B \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(A,B)\to \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{D}}(F(A),F(B))$ is surjective

를 만족하면 $F$를 full functor라 한다.

Category $\mathbf{Cat}, \mathbf{CAT}$을

$\mathrm{Ob}(\mathbf{Cat})$ : small categories,$\mkern99mu \mathrm{Mor}(\mathbf{Cat})$ : functors

$\mathrm{Ob}(\mathbf{CAT})$ : locally small categories,$\qquad \mathrm{Mor}(\mathbf{Cat})$ : functors

으로 정의한다.

Functor $F,G \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{D}$에 대하여 class function

$\begin{aligned} \eta \colon \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}) & \to \mathrm{Mor}(\mathcal{D}) \\[-0.25em] A\quad & \mapsto \quad\eta_{A}\quad \in \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{D}}(F(A),G(A)) \end{aligned}$

가 다음 조건

$\forall f \in \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(A,B),\;\eta_{A} \circ G(f) = F(f) \circ \eta_{B}$

\begin{tikzpicture} \node at (-3,2) {$F(A)$}; \node at (3,2) {$F(B)$}; \node at (-3,-2) {$G(A)$}; \node at (3,-2) {$G(B)$}; \draw[->] (-1.25,2) -- node[above] {$\scriptstyle F(f)$} (1.25,2); \draw[->] (-1.25,-2) -- node[below] {$\scriptstyle G(f)$} (1.25,-2); \draw[->] (-3,1) -- node[left] {$\scriptstyle \eta_{A}$} (-3,-1); \draw[->] (3,1) -- node[right] {$\scriptstyle \eta_{B}$} (3,-1); \end{tikzpicture}

을 만족하면 $\eta$를 natural transformation이라 하고, $\eta \colon F \Rightarrow G$로 표시한다.

1.

모든 $A \in \mathrm{Ob(\mathcal{C})}$에 대하여 $\eta_{A}$가 isomorphism이면, $\eta$를 natural isomorphism이라 한다.

Functor $F \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{D},\;G \colon \mathcal{D} \to \mathcal{C}$에 대하여 natural isomorphisms

$\eta \colon \mathrm{id}_{\mathcal{C}} \overset{\cong}{\Rightarrow} GF,\quad \varepsilon \colon F\:\!G \overset{\cong}{\Rightarrow} \mathrm{id}_{\mathcal{D}}$

이 존재하면 $F$를 equivalence of categories라 한다. 두 category $\mathcal{C},\mathcal{D}$ 사이에 equivalence가 존재하면, $\mathcal{C},\mathcal{D}$를 equivalent하다고 하며 $\mathcal{C} \simeq \mathcal{D}$로 표시한다. Isomorphism (in $\mathbf{CAT}$)은 당연히 equivalence이다.

1.

$F$는 equivalence $\iff \begin{aligned}[t] & F \text{ is fully faithful} \\ & \forall B \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{D}),\;\ \exists A \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; B \cong F(A) \end{aligned}$

(Locally small) Category $\mathcal{C}$에 대하여 functor $F \colon \mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}} \to \mathbf{Set} \;(G \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathbf{Set})$이

$\forall A \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}) \quad \text{and} \quad \exists \Phi \colon \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(-,A) \overset{\cong}{\Longrightarrow} F$

$\big(\forall A \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}) \quad \text{and} \quad \exists \Phi \colon \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(A,-) \overset{\cong}{\Longrightarrow} G\big)$

를 만족하면 $F$를 representable functor라 한다. 이 때 natural isomorphism $\Phi$를 representation of $F$라 하고, $A$를 universal object for $F$라 한다. 또한 Yoneda lemma에 의하여 $\Phi$에 대응되는 $u = \Phi_{A}(\mathrm{id}_A) \in F(A)$를 universal element라 한다.

(Locally small) Category $\mathcal{C}$와 functor $F \colon \mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}} \to \mathbf{Set} \;(G \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathbf{Set})$에 대하여

$\forall A \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; \mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(-,A),F) \cong F(A)$

$\big(\forall A \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal{C}),\; \mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(A,-),G) \cong G(A)\big)$

이며$(\eta \mapsto \eta_{A}(\mathrm{id}_{A}))$, 이 때

$\mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(\,\cdot\,,-),F) \Rightarrow F(-), \quad \mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(\,\cdot\,,A),-) \Rightarrow -(A)$

$\big(\mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(-,\,\cdot\,),G) \Rightarrow G(-), \quad \mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(A,\,\cdot\,),-) \Rightarrow -(A)\big)$

는 natural isomorphism이다. [Yoneda Lemma]

1.

Functors

$\begin{gathered} \mathrm{Hom}(\,\cdot\,,-) \colon \mathcal{C} \to \mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}}}, & A \mapsto \mathrm{Hom}(A,-) \\[-0.25em] \mathrm{Hom}(-,\,\cdot\,) \colon \mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}} \to \mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{C}}, & A \mapsto \mathrm{Hom}(-,A)\end{gathered}$

를 Yoneda embedding이라 하며, Yoneda lemma에 의하여

$\begin{gathered} \mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(-,A),\mathrm{Hom}(-,B)) \cong \mathrm{Hom}(A,B) \\[-0.25em] \mathrm{Hom}(\mathrm{Hom}(A,-),\mathrm{Hom}(B,-)) \cong \mathrm{Hom}(B,A) \end{gathered}$

가 성립한다
